name: example-google-cloud-scc
note: Reference mapping for a Google Cloud Security Command Center findings export (MCE-04). Records have the REST API's ListFindingsResult shape (a `finding` and a `resource` object), which the command-line listing prints as JSON. States are the published Finding.State enum: ACTIVE is a problem the source still reports (FAIL); INACTIVE covers a fixed finding and one a person closed as not an issue, which the export cannot tell apart, so it is UNKNOWN with the state kept in detail, never PASS. A muted ACTIVE finding stays FAIL. Each finding is one resource, so finding.name is the per-record identity (AUD-F77); it carries the organization id and becomes an opaque record id before export, as the project id becomes an opaque scope. Category-to-KSI bindings are the provider's declaration, for illustration only. Undeclared categories are skipped and counted, never exported unbound.
